name: Perplexity Comet Competitor Analysis Agent
headline: Competitor Analysis Report Generator: Automate
short_description: This skill enables users to perform live competitor analysis across multiple browser tabs and export the findings into a well-organized Google Document. It saves time by automating data extraction and report generation.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The Competitor Analysis Report Generator is an innovative Claude Code skill designed to streamline the process of conducting live competitor analysis. By enabling users to gather data across multiple browser tabs and automatically compile it into a well-organized Google Document, this skill significantly reduces the manual effort typically involved in market research. Users can quickly extract insights from various web sources, making it easier to stay ahead in competitive landscapes. One of the key benefits of this AI automation skill is the time savings it offers. While the exact time savings are not quantified, the automation of data extraction and report generation allows users to focus on analyzing the information rather than spending hours compiling it. This efficiency is particularly beneficial for developers, product managers, and marketing professionals who require timely insights to inform their strategies and decisions. This skill is ideal for professionals involved in marketing, product development, and competitive analysis. Whether you're a product manager looking to understand market trends or a marketing professional needing to generate detailed competitor reports, this tool simplifies the process. For example, a marketing team can use this skill to quickly compile competitor pricing strategies and product features, enabling them to adjust their offerings accordingly. With a beginner difficulty level, the Competitor Analysis Report Generator can be implemented in just 15 minutes, making it accessible for users with varying technical backgrounds. It fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows by automating repetitive tasks, allowing teams to leverage AI automation for enhanced productivity. By integrating this skill into your daily operations, you can ensure that your team remains agile and informed in a rapidly changing market.
Perform live competitor analysis for marketing insights
Generate detailed competitor reports from multiple web sources
Automate the export of research findings into Google Docs
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
Perform a competitor analysis for [TARGET_BUSINESS] by examining the open browser tabs of [COMPETITOR_1], [COMPETITOR_2], and [COMPETITOR_3]. Extract key insights from their web pages, focusing on [ANALYSIS_CRITERIA]. Save the analysis into a new Google Document titled '[REPORT_TITLE]'.
```
Copy

```
Performed competitor analysis for Gamma by analyzing three competitors. Extracted insights include pricing strategies, product offerings, and customer engagement tactics. Report saved in Google Document titled 'Gamma Competitor Analysis Report'.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
